Origin: feminine of H5695
Translated in the KJV: calf, cow, heifer.
H5698:
Eglah, a wife of David
Origin: the same as H5697
Translated in the KJV: Eglah.
H5699:
something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle
Origin: from the same as H5696
Translated in the KJV: cart, chariot, wagon
